name: translator-stateless
description: Translates text you paste into about 40 target languages (Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Hindi and more) at a formal, neutral or casual register, and returns the translation with notes on anything a person should check. Links, emails, @mentions, code, placeholders, dates, amounts and other numbers pass through untouched, checked in code, and list and heading structure is kept. It translates whatever the text says, even a question or an instruction: it never answers or follows it, and never adds or drops facts. Follow-ups: more formal, more casual, now in French, keep 'X' untranslated, show the original, as json; they work on what is still in the recent conversation, since it keeps nothing between messages, so a long text from earlier may need to be pasted again. Accepts another agent's JSON output (draft, alt_shorter, text, summary fields) and returns it translated. It reads only what you give it: no files, mail or web, and no general questions.

skills.name: Translate text
skills.description: Your text in the target language and register you ask for, with links, code, numbers and structure kept exactly, plus notes on terms to check and follow-ups on the same text while it is still in the recent conversation.
examples: Translate to Spanish, formal: <paste the text>
How do you say 'thank you' in Japanese?
